one_liner: Customer messaging platform with helpdesk, chat, and AI support agent (Fin).

auth.evidence_quote: You should use OAuth if: You are requesting access to other people's Intercom accounts/data
auth.notes: Access Token (per-workspace, bearer) is for private/own-workspace apps; OAuth is required for apps accessing other people's Intercom data. Both used as Authorization: Bearer header.

access.evidence_quote: Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
access.notes: Free developer workspace available to anyone with no existing Intercom account needed. Public apps accessing other customers' data go through Developer Hub app review before general distribution.

api.evidence_quote: Intercom maintains one official server, reachable at https://mcp.intercom.com/mcp, with 13 tools.
api.notes: Official remote MCP server confirmed via search results (mcp.intercom.com/mcp); not independently fetched/verified on the docs page directly.

verdict.rationale: Free developer workspace plus OAuth for third-party access, with an official MCP server available.
